tips.description: Visit Tsukiji Outer Market early morning for the freshest sushi. The lines at Daiwa Sushi are worth the wait!
Book Colosseum tickets online at least 2 days in advance to skip the long queues. Best time to visit is early morning.
For the best view of Eiffel Tower, go to Trocadero广场 during sunset. Free and less crowded!
